text:
maria: Heads up — multiple customers hitting empty Insights tiles in Console. Graphs are just a gray frame or 'No data', and I see a bunch of 500 responses from the analytics API starting ~16:34 UTC. cc @samir for triage, and @julie if this looks like infra.
samir: On it. Do you have a repro URL or a correlation id from one of the failed requests? Any pattern (time range, panel type)?
maria: Example dashboard: /orgs/acme/dash/heatmap-usage, panel id=42. Customer reported with correlation id c-id: 5f7a9b23. I pulled a request from the browser devtools:
maria: ```curl -i \"https://api.redwood/internal/analytics/query?panel=42&range=7d&step=60\" 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer xxxxx\"
  -H \"X-Correlation-ID: 5f7a9b23\"
```
maria: Response is HTTP/1.1 500 and body: `{"error":"query execution timeout","code":"ANLQ_TIMEOUT"}`. There are many similar ones in the last 20m.
samir: Thanks. I can see matching 500s in analytics-prod logs for that correlation id. Quick extract:
samir: ```[2024-12-03T16:35:02Z] ERROR query_service handler:panel=42 user=acme req_id=5f7a9b23 err="clickhouse: query cancelled: deadline exceeded" trace=...
[2024-12-03T16:35:02Z] WARN cpu-saturation: compute_pool busy=98% queue=120
```
samir: Looks like timeouts while waiting on ClickHouse reads; also queue backpressure on the compute pool. I'll check the aggregator and CH connection metrics.
julie: I see a spike in query latency on the analytics cluster at 16:32-16:36 UTC. Two nodes showed connection resets to ClickHouse. Possible partial outage in the replica set. I'm scaling aggregator-replica count now and restarting the most erroring worker  analytics-processor-7.
kai: From the frontend side, we suppress retries for 500s to avoid thundering herd; that means tiles show empty instead of a retry. For an immediate mitigation we could show cached/stale data if available while backend is recovering. Want me to ship a quick toggle? :thinking_face:
maria: Please hold on UI changes for now — we need to confirm root cause. Support queue is flooding though; customers are asking for ETA.
samir: I found a slowish query pattern: panels that request `group_by=region` with `range=7d` and high resolution (step=30/60) generate large fanout and hit long-running merges in ClickHouse. Combined with the node resets it's causing queue pileup. Temporary mitigation: route high-resolution panel queries to lower-resolution fallback model (step=300) for 5m. I can add a routing rule in the traffic router to do that for panels with step<=60 and range>3d.
julie: Approved. I'm applying a scaled up compute pool and opening a ClickHouse incident ticket with infra team. If the router change helps we'll roll it for 10m and monitor.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-1123 analytics cluster read errors. Pager duty notified (oncall: eng-sre). Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2024-1123
maria: I pushed repro steps to the support ticket: how to reproduce with curl + sample panel id and correlation id. Also added customer impact note and list of affected orgs.
samir: Router change applied (temporary): redirecting high-res queries -> aggregated-300s pathway. Patch diff:
samir: ```diff
- if (req.step <= 60 && req.range_days > 3) { route = normal; }
+ if (req.step <= 60 && req.range_days > 3) { route = aggregated_300s; add_header: X-Fallback-Route }
```
samir: After routing change I see 500 rate drop from 6% -> 0.4% over 3m. ClickHouse connections stabilized a bit.
julie: I'm seeing CPU and IO drop on the hottest CH nodes, and queue length in compute pool is down from 120 -> 15. Keeping a close eye on error rate.
kai: Frontend is toggled to show "stale data available" banner when we get an X-Fallback-Route header, so affected tiles will show last-successful data instead of empty frame. Pushing change now.
maria: Customer comms: told affected users we have a mitigation in place and are rolling out a temporary routing change; ETA for full recovery TBD. Folks are satisfied for now but asking for root cause postmortem.
samir: Next steps: I will run a replay of the slow queries against a CH replica to reproduce the merge behavior and capture the query profile. julie to follow up on node stability and infra RCA. kai to keep the stale-data banner in prod for 24h if needed.
julie: Created infra ticket CH-2024-87 to replace the failing disk on node ch-node-3 and to audit network flaps. Assigning to infra-storage.
maria: Thanks all. I'll mark support tickets with the incident link and update customers in batches. Please post final postmortem once infra and analytics confirm root cause.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2024-1123 status: mitigated (routing fallback applied). Monitoring for 1h.
